# Kilotest

Kilotest is a powerful web validator. It integrates an ensemble of 12 rule engines (Axe, HTML CodeSniffer, QualWeb, Nu Html Checker, etc.), with about 1,300 rules, to audit web pages for front-end quality (accessibility, usability, and W3C web standards, including HTML, CSS, ARIA, and WCAG). Each test job generates a standardized public report describing which elements violated which rules and grouping the violations into about 380 issues. Kilotest can list the tested sites and pages, the reports about each page, the issues in each report, the elements violating rules belonging to each issue, and the diagnoses of each violation. Kilotest also accepts requests to test pages not yet tested and to retest already tested pages. Kilotest features are available via a web UI, an API, and a hosted remote MCP server with streamable HTTP and no authentication.

## API

- [List all tested sites](/api/listSites) (`GET`)
- List the tested pages of one site, with links to test results: `/api/listPages/{siteID}` (`GET`)
- List all issues in one report, and all reports about the same page: `/api/listIssues/{reportID}` (`GET`)
- List all elements violating rules belonging to one issue in one report: `/api/listViolators/{issueID}/{reportID}` (`GET`)
- List all diagnoses of one element violating rules belonging to one issue in one report: `/api/listDiagnoses/{issueID}/{reportID}/{catalogIndex}` (`GET`)
- Question a diagnosis: `/api/questionDiagnosis/{issueID}/{reportID}/{catalogIndex}` (`POST`)
- Get one full report in JSON: `/api/getReport/{reportID}` (`GET`)
- Request testing of a not-yet-tested web page: `/api/requestNewTest` (`POST`)
- Request retesting of a web page: `/api/requestRetest/{reportID}` (`POST`)
- Wait for a job to complete: `/api/awaitTest/{reportID}` (`POST`)
- Request adding or improving a feature: `/api/requestFeature` (`POST`)

## MCP Server

- [MCP server for Kilotest](https://kilotest.com/mcp)

## Web UI

- [Home page](https://kilotest.com/)
- [List all tested sites](https://kilotest.com/listSites.html)
- List the tested pages of one site, with links to test results: `https://kilotest.com/listPages.html/{siteID}`
- List all issues in one report, and all reports about the same page: `https://kilotest.com/listIssues.html/{reportID}`
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listViolators.html/{issueID}/{reportID}`
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listDiagnoses.html/{issueID}/{reportID}/{catalogIndex}`
- Get one full report in JSON: `https://kilotest.com/fullReport.json/{reportID}`
- [Request testing of a web page of a site not yet tested](https://kilotest.com/requestNewTestForm.html)
- Request testing of a not-yet-tested web page of a tested site: `https://kilotest.com/requestNewTestForm.html/{siteID}`
- Request retesting of a web page: `https://kilotest.com/requestRetestForm.html/{reportID}`
- [List the operations available to Kilotest managers](https://kilotest.com/manage.html)
- [Get statistics about frequently reported issues across all pages](https://kilotest.com/listTopIssues.html)
- [List the incompletely tested pages, with the rule engines that could not test them, per the latest report about each page](https://kilotest.com/listPreventingPages.html)
- [List the rule engines that could not test pages, with those pages, per the latest report about each page](https://kilotest.com/listPreventedEngines.html)
- [List the sets of rules that the same elements violated on every page on which the rules were tested, per the latest report about each page](https://kilotest.com/listRuleMatches.html)
- List those sets of rules, requiring a chosen minimum number (at least 2; default 3) of pages on which the rules were violated: `https://kilotest.com/listRuleMatches.html/{minPages}`
- [Tutorial, “Accessibility testing strategies”](https://kilotest.com/tutorialWeb.html)
- [Tutorial, “Kilotest and AI”](https://kilotest.com/tutorialAI.html)
